## Fixed: the browser extension downloaded the wrong TikTok video

- **The video you click, not another one.** On TikTok's feed the post around the player has no link to its own video, so the extension looked further and further out and took the first video link anywhere on the page, such as a video in your notifications. It now looks only inside the post that holds the player you clicked, and on TikTok reads the video's number from the player itself. If it can't tell, NDM says to open the video's own page instead of downloading a different video.
- **No "Exit NDM" window while an update installs.** The small "Saving settings..." note now shows only when you quit NDM yourself.

The browser extension updates itself to 2.7.3; if an open TikTok tab still uses the old one, reload the tab.
